classes.name: The Last Warden
classes.blurb: You held a door once, alone, all night, and it held. Sword and shield and the patience to let the enemy make the first mistake — the keep was built by people who fought the way you fight, which is why you can read its dangers where others read decoration. Reach is your language; the stew in your pack is the whole of your mercy toward yourself.

classes.name: The Steeple Archer
classes.blurb: You learned your trade shooting gulls off the bell towers of a living coast. Nothing in this keep survives being seen first, and you are very good at seeing first. Open every fight on your terms or not at all; the dagger is for the conversations that get close anyway. You packed two stews, because you plan on needing fewer.

classes.name: The Lampbearer
classes.blurb: Pilgrims paid you to walk ahead of them with a light, back when there were pilgrims. You know what the others never learn: most of what kills people in the dark was visible the whole time. You set your torches in the corners you have already cleared, so no one has to clear them twice. Travel light, look twice, and the keep runs out of surprises.

classes.name: The Underminer
classes.blurb: Every keep is two keeps: the one on the plans and the one water and neglect have been quietly building underneath. You worked the second one. A stone in the right pool has started more fights on your terms than any blade, and ended a few, too. Throw, listen, move — and keep the hatchet for whatever the noise brings back.
